yields.label: Food
yields.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): agriculture, livestock, forestry and fishing (CNAE section A).

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): mining (B), manufacturing (C) and construction (F), the US map's three industries.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross domestic product at market prices, current euros (INE Contabilidad Regional de España). INE publishes it down to provinces, so cities have no Gold of their own.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): information & communication (J) and professional, scientific & technical services (M).

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): arts, entertainment & recreation (R).

industries.other: Other services, households as employers, extraterritorial bodies
